build.label: Public Windows playtest baseline
build.tested: Original automated checks: 151 EditMode, 58 PlayMode, 11 packaged runtime gates. Fresh sanitized-package headless smoke passed; public full-download hash verified. Human/Steam/Deck acceptance remains pending.
build.sourceLabel: Earlier private playtest, October 11 UTC: Normal/Zombie selection, Start New / Load Saved Game / Resume, six campaign stages and revised first-person hands. That released aee0f8e package passed 506 selected native tests and nine exact-package checks, real menu/save relaunch and reviewed captures. Its sign-in-required link above is unchanged. The later uncommitted endless-survival recovery has separate evidence and open gates in Production; its diagnostic is not a replacement download. Public 1d79ef7 and historical screenshots stay unchanged. Human listening/gameplay, separate-PC Steam/network and physical Deck/controller acceptance remain pending.
manifest: Solo hunt or LAN camps for up to six players, hosted-camp list, manual address and reconnect support
Deer, elk and antelope hunting; trophy harvesting and hauling; shared camp money and upgrades
224-metre Forest, Snow and Fire map, lake, roaming wildlife and four discoverable respawn/upgrade camps
Bow, knife, rifles, RPG/rapid-RPG upgrades, earned alien raygun and reclaimable purchased weapons
Carry/stow/throw cargo, four-item capacity upgrades, magnetic returns, camp hoop and 25-item collection vehicle
Horseshoes, marshmallow roasting/eating, rhythm camp band and stake-free blackjack
Complete The Camels - Jam Session recording and retained elk-caller audio
Bear, Bigfoot, skeleton and UFO/mothership encounters, alien rewards, gunship progression and historical nuke finale

stages.title: Protect the hunt
stages.summary: Current bugs, audio and RPG performance.
criteria: Fix reported defects and audio issues with repeatable playtest evidence
Optimize lag without nerfing 1d79ef7 perk stacking, projectiles, damage or ammo
First-person remains primary; third-person supports character inspection
Compass and clearer upgrade navigation pass usability review
stages.blocker: The earlier aee0f8e playtest passed 506 selected native tests and nine exact-package gates, with reviewed captures and real menu/save flows. Later recovery evidence is separate in Production. Human usability, listening and supported-hardware acceptance remain pending.

stages.title: Three worlds. One identity.
stages.summary: All-biome asset polish, with the strongest pass reserved for the fire finale.
criteria: Forest, snow and fire assets pass visual and performance review
Natural terrain and forage feel coherent
Polar bear and snow tracks verified in play
Rare Christmas trees and late-snow red-nosed reindeer encounter verified
20+ live elk lead to Santa boss, present and camp outfit unlock
stages.blocker: Art and encounter acceptance require in-game review.

stages.title: Survive what follows
stages.summary: Earlier mode/menu/save work is available in the private aee0f8e playtest. The later endless Zombie recovery, remaining bosses, destruction, NPC quests and progression have separate acceptance gates in Production.
criteria: Normal Forest / Snow / Fire progression and independent endless Zombie runs preserve unlocks, host authority and saves; Start New never overwrites an existing slot
Main-menu Zombie Mode includes all species and unrestricted-distance pursuit
Fire undead-elk boss passes gameplay and balance review
Special signature weapons roll independently at 33% per kill; no third-kill guarantee
Destruction, NPC quests and progression pass complete-loop tests
Normal mode’s nuke ending is realistic and entirely in-scene, with no AI video. Endless Zombie has no win, nuke or finale.
stages.blocker: Earlier menu/save and two-process Zombie encounter checks passed; they do not validate the uncommitted recovery. Its measured Horde failure and integrated survival limits stay open in Production. Complete-loop human play, balance and other requested content remain unfinished.

stages.title: Bring the whole party
criteria: Six players complete a synchronized full session
Defined supported hardware/settings sustain minimum 30 FPS; 60 FPS preferred
Steam Deck controls, readability and performance measured
Performance improvements preserve gameplay semantics
stages.blocker: Six-process and dedicated two-process Zombie co-op checks passed on one computer. Separate-PC Internet/Steam, six physical players, hardware frame times and physical Deck/controller acceptance remain unverified.

stages.title: Earn the release
stages.summary: Steamworks onboarding, store and build review, then release.
criteria: Onboarding, app identity and app-fee payment date verified privately
First-title 21-day fee clock and 14-day public Coming Soon requirement satisfied
Store/pricing/content survey approved, then playable build approved
Purchase, install and launch smoke tests pass
Dashboard confirms seasonal discount eligibility and saved discount
stages.blocker: All account and approval gates remain unverified. Sale participation is not guaranteed.

decisions.title: In-scene finale
decisions.text: The old 30-45 second video requirement is cancelled. Normal mode’s nuclear ending must be realistic and rendered entirely in the game scene. Endless Zombie has no win, nuke or finale.

decisions.title: Preserve RPG behavior
decisions.text: Optimization must preserve the current 1d79ef7 perk stacking, projectile, damage and ammo semantics.

decisions.title: Independent loot rolls
decisions.text: Signature weapon drops use an independent 33% chance per kill, with no guaranteed third drop.
